summary: November 28, 2026: The creator’s current Seance website and README identify Ootle mainnet. Today’s individual receipt and resource reads returned HTTP 403, and explorer text extraction returned empty content; those reads do not establish current receipt availability. The current deployment classification uses the hosted page, creator migration evidence and matching current template catalogues. The new genuine recording is a scrolling README walkthrough with scripts and downloads disabled, not a decryption or payment test. The previous seance-v2 source, destination and October recording remain in the provenance history. This project is distinct from DevXTools’ sealed polls.
